title: Extensions of Centrally Essential Rings
summary: A non-zero unital ring $R$ is said to be centrally essential if for every nonzero element $a$ of $R$, there exist non-zero central elements $x$ and $y$ with $ax = y$. In the paper, almost fully prime centrally essential rings are described in terms of ideal extensions, centrally essential Dorroh extensions, and trivial extensions.
